verses.text: Job continued speaking:
"As surely as God lives, who has refused me justice, the Almighty, who has made my life bitter,
as long as I have life in me and the breath of God is in my nose,
my lips will not say anything evil, and my tongue will not tell lies.
I will never say that you are right. Until the day I die, I will not stop saying I am innocent.
I will hold on to my innocence and never let it go. My conscience will not blame me as long as I live.
Let my enemy be treated like the wicked. Let anyone who attacks me be treated like the evil.
What hope do godless people have when God cuts them off and takes away their lives?
Will God listen to their cry when trouble comes on them?
Will they find joy in the Almighty? Will they call on God all the time?
I will teach you about God's power. I will not hide what the Almighty does.
You have all seen it for yourselves. So why do you keep talking such nonsense?
This is what God has planned for evil people, what cruel people will receive from the Almighty:
They may have many children, but the sword will kill them. Their descendants will never have enough to eat.
Disease will kill those who survive, and their widows will not even cry for them.
They may pile up silver like dust and clothes like piles of clay.
But good people will wear those clothes, and innocent people will share the silver.
The houses they build are like a moth's cocoon, like a hut put up by a guard in a field.
They go to bed rich, but it will be for the last time. When they open their eyes, everything is gone.
Terrors flood over them. A storm snatches them away in the night.
The east wind carries them off, and they are gone. It sweeps them out of their place.
It blows against them without mercy as they try to escape its power.
It claps its hands at them and hisses at them as they leave their place."
